Excuse my request, Takashi-san.
I would like to request my TRPG character again!

She is a young girl from CoC "napfrappe" HOMoon.
She is wearing a prison uniform + shorts + pink hoodie.
Gray eyes (white is ok), double teeth, green hair.

Again, I would like to request her as a mini-mini SD.
I would love to display her as a small acrylic figure!

Thank you again for the opportunity to work with you.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14-Q6NU9H7NLVJrZn1VfwsqqwK3hHbv4_

Canceled once! Sorry. I wanted to request a change of content.

I would like to request the following girl's mini mini SD! I would be happy if she is healthy and smiling.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13WgLaCpuHCFnM_Nvl9-w96iPALlwInE7

Please consider our request! We will continue to support you.

Good evening, Takashi-san! Thank you for your help. I would like to make a request again. I would like to request the following two people.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13N8OMCIIMdY5olHmkbpC6KuUPDitzpdu

 The two people are from the CoC scenario "The Love Corruption of Lotka Volterra".

  https://skeb.jp/@34_lol7/works/26
↑We would like to have them portrayed as two mini-minis as in this work! I would like to use them as icons.

We would like to have a miniature portrait of the two of them as shown in this work.

We would appreciate it if you could depict them together!

Mr. Takashi.

Hello! Thank you very much for your continued support.

What I would like to request this time is the 2-headed deformation of two OC people that I requested before.
I would like to make them look like a pair of icons, so I would like to ask you to make them into a pair.

We would also appreciate it if you could deliver the transparent version as well, as we may be able to make some goods within our personal range.

I would be very grateful if you could accept my request.
Thank you very much!

Please excuse me for sending this request.

Icon size is fine!

I would be very happy to accept your request, thank you very much.

Hello, Mr. Takashi.
I would like to request a handout angel child for a scenario called "Kaiibutsu to Mahora cult".
Currently I have not passed it, but I have plans to do so.

She will be a timid girl with a communication disorder who is smart but has trouble putting it into words because of her personality. She is small, 148cm tall.

If possible, I would be happy if she has teary eyes and a confident expression. I would also like her to be sitting rather than standing.

She may or may not have horns as shown in the picture. Please choose the one you think is cute.

Thank you again.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-tMl3TP8ztPSq2pxcSJZibzLuquOVALi

Hello Takashi.
Please excuse my request.

I would like to request a standing picture of a girl.

She should have a bob cut (intake would be nice). She should have a bob cut, light brown color, and gray eyes.
I would also like her pose to be energetic.
Her personality is also energetic, optimistic, and she lives her life thinking "I can make it work.

I would be very grateful if you could accept my request!
Thank you very much.

Thank you very much...!

Hello!  I found your art on twitter and absolutely adore it.  Could you draw my FFXIV OC's together?  They are a couple.  The viera is a healer, gentle, kind, easily embarrassed and always falling asleep.  He has grey hair and one red and one white eye.  He has a bunny tail but you do not need to draw it.  The Au Ra is a warrior, possessive, smug, but also extremely caring towards the viera.  He has black / red hair, and grey eyes with a black outer ring.

For the pose, maybe something where the Au Ra is defending the Viera?  I'm not picky though so if you want to do something else with them you can!

Ref:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10Jrp4D25wUBqb8ZRnF_R-h9uXtqLSZlc?usp=sharing

I apologize for any rudeness.

Thank you!
